Sends HTTP Basic authentication header

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { AuthConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { auth: { password: "testpass", type: "basic", username: "testuser" } as AuthConfig, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.authHeaderSent);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
}

void main();
```
